cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Record My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Will you put my name under 'cake design' before you frame our club's prize certificate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Next year's members won't. There's a blank ready for them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We usually credit the whole baking team.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: List us all, with what each did. I'll fetch everyone's names before you seal the frame.
